Corpus › Control flow › 靜默

靜默

Translation status: 繁體中文 reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the zh-Hant pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Marks an explicit no-op statement.

Aliases: silent noop

Syntax: 靜默

Category#

transfer

Related#

  • 則
  • 傳回

Examples#

radix/corpus/tacet/tacet.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Marks an explicit no-op statement.

# =============================================================================
# 靜默 — Marks an explicit no-op statement.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Explicit no-op — `靜默` as a deliberate empty statement, especially in control flow
#   • Musical rest metaphor — `靜默` signals intentional absence of action
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • using 靜默 where logic is expected, which hides missing code; 靜默 is also outside the v1 AIR pure subset
#
# See also: 則, 傳回
# =============================================================================


# 靜默 — explicit no-op (musical rest)
#
# 靜默                                    -- deliberate empty statement
# 若 <cond> 則 靜默                     -- guarded no-op
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   noopStmt :← '靜默'
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   cond 真, finis (tacet.expected).

fn maybeNota(bool cond) → void {
    if cond {
        print "cond verum"
    }
    else {
        # deliberate no-op in else branch
        pass
    }
}

main {
    # prints
    maybeNota(true)
    # 靜默 — no output
    maybeNota(false)

    # condition false, so 靜默 never runs
    if false then pass

    print "finis"
}

Expected output:

cond verum
finis
